name: claude-code-skills
description: Claude Code skills built from real IT and web-development work and sharpened by using them: a read-only web security auditor, and a protocol for handing work off unattended at the end of the day.

plugins.name: censor
plugins.description: Read-only web-app security auditor: black-box probe + semgrep baseline rules + gitleaks + optional LLM source review, producing a severity-ranked advisory. Invoke as /censor:censor (bare /censor if installed as a copied skill).

plugins.name: vesper
plugins.description: Vesper - govern unattended end-of-day work. Hand off work on your way out and it maximises what gets done without a human, never blocks on a question, defers what must wait, and leaves one committed resume point that a SessionStart hook surfaces the next morning. Invoke as /vesper:vesper, /vesper:vesper full, /vesper:vesper resume, /vesper:vesper setup (bare /vesper if installed as a copied skill).
